name: Cross Concerto
source:
It was spring, the season of new beginnings. Satoru finally broke free from the closed remote village where he had been held captive as an unwanted child, and entered the same school that his late mother attended. However, he was surprised to find his twin sister Ruri and her attendant Kyouka waiting for him there. He met the cool senpai Touko and occult-loving student council leader Mirai and gradually got used to the dormitory life. However, there were figures working in the shadows; will they find out the truth behind the events around them?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/09/01/september-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
春天是万物伊始的季节。悟终于逃离了那个把他当作多余孩子囚禁起来的封闭偏远村庄，进入已故母亲曾就读的同一所学校。然而，他惊讶地发现双胞胎妹妹琉璃和她的侍从京香正在那里等他。他遇见了冷静的学姐冬子和热爱灵异的学生会长未来，逐渐适应宿舍生活。

然而，有些身影正在暗中活动；他们能否发现身边事件背后的真相？

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/09/01/september-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
